intended_use: Operational template for applying the collapse/correction evaluation protocol to a new model-scaffold pair.

scope.primary_claim: family/model-level ranking and evaluation discipline, not universal benchmark transfer or a deployable controller
scope.recommended_first_use: selection-time triage followed by held-out signed-utility replay
scope.required_assumption_note: State whether the question pool is model-specific high-FR, shared high-FR, full-pool, or target-task calibrated; high-FR pool selection must be outcome-blind and reported.

alpha_lite_triage.description: One condition/agent pass for cheap screening; follow with richer trace logging if the signal is high.

paper_full_fingerprint.description: Three conditions times three agents, matching the psychometric estimate used for the reported stress rows.

direct_debate_audit.description: Current trace implementation logs roughly 3 initial answers plus 4 rounds times 3 agents per question.

cost_card_200_question_slice.caveat: Dollar cost depends on backend, output length, and whether the light or full fingerprint is used; the full fingerprint is not claimed to be universally cheaper than a small debate sweep.
